independenceNotes: Wisdom Library and Gurudev Sivananda English Shiva Purana are the SAME Shastri translation, not independent recensions. Sanskrit Wikisource supplies a separate-language published witness; Drik supplies traditional roop association, not the Purana plot.

Devi Mahatmya narratives compared with Sanskrit Documents Sanskrit and Pargiter 1904 English; GRIET PDF is a second host of Pargiter, not a different translation. Anandamayi PDF has selected hymns, not complete narrative corroboration.

Kushmanda cosmic-smile and Siddhidatri Shiva-Shakti associations are expressly attributed devotional accounts corroborated by Drik Panchang and Art of Living. Dhyana supplies form/name, not independent proof of origin. Art of Living depicts Kushmanda on a tiger; art follows Drik lion variant.

Shakambhari narrative compared with Sanskrit Documents Devi Bhagavata excerpt and Vijnanananda 1921 Sacred Texts. Greenmesg was browser-read; its 54-byte local denial is excluded from cached-source evidence.
No claim that a source is a critical edition or that two publication hosts are independent textual recensions. Source notes identify selected tradition and adaptation boundaries.
Modern translation wording and guide prose are not reproduced. Public-domain older translations are comparison witnesses. All app narration is newly authored.
